verdict.rationale: Factory documents droid exec as a one-shot CLI runner built for CI/CD pipelines and general task delegation with diff review/PR creation, which are the building blocks for a CI-failure-fix workflow, but there is no explicit documentation of Factory detecting a failed CI run, diagnosing the failure, and opening a proposed PR fix as an integrated feature. missing for 10: explicit CI-failure detection/trigger mechanism, automated root-cause diagnosis of failing CI logs, and a documented end-to-end 'failed workflow -> PR fix' example or case study.
